amount.hint: Water slowly until it runs from the drainage holes, then empty the saucer

presets.light: Bright, indirect light; shield from harsh midday sun
tips: Roots rot in soggy soil, so never leave the pot standing in water.
From autumn to late winter growth slows: let the soil dry a little more.
Prefers humid air; keep it away from radiators and draughts.
